title: Jensen Huang Says AI Layoffs Are 'Lazy' — What That Actually Means
metaDescription: Nvidia CEO calls AI layoff excuses lazy. While execs fumble narratives, smart workers are quietly building AI skills that matter.
author: Marty @ CertFlo

sections.heading: What Jensen Huang Actually Said
sections.body: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang just called out executives who blame layoffs on AI. Told reporters some CEOs are using AI as a 'lazy' excuse to sound smart about workforce cuts that have nothing to do with automation. Here's the thing though — while executives are making excuses, there's this group of workers quietly building the biggest advantage in years. The Business Insider report basically confirms what you probably already suspected: most companies aren't actually replacing humans with AI. They're just using AI talk to cover for bad management decisions. Timing's interesting if you know what to look for.
